title: Coefficient 3: self-contained affine-disperser gate elimination (3N - O(N^(4/5)))

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total family f defined in proof.md Section 1: f_0=0; for N>=1 let k be the least prime with k^5>=32N^3, m=N-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)); if not (k<N, r>=2, r+2<=k) then f_N=0. Otherwise the input is w=(q_0..q_{k-1},x_1..x_m); q(z)=z^k+sum q_j z^j; if the test T(q) [z^(2^k)=z mod q, q(0)=1, q(1)=1] fails, f_N(w)=0; else, in K=F_2[z]/(q), pad x with zeros into r blocks u_i in polynomial basis, y_i=u_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1), and f_N(w)=Tr(E_t(y_1,...,y_r)), the trace of the t-th elementary symmetric polynomial.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"3"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"3"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total family, computable in deterministic polynomial time (hence in NP with the empty witness), C_B2(f_N)>=3N-252*N^(4/5) for every integer N>=2^29 at actual input length N in the full Li-Yang B2 model; hence C_B2(f_N)>=(3-o(1))N at every sufficiently large integer length.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
